first_run.note: Intentional regression: added a system-prompt rule requiring confirmation before every refund/cancellation.

second_run.note: Prompt fully reverted to the original (byte-identical diff), but e-002 still failed 2 of 5 trials, down from 5/5 in the original baseline.

explanation: The revert restored the exact original system prompt, but the second CI run still blocked because e-002 passed only 2 of 5 trials instead of 5 of 5. This is not an infrastructure error -- all 5 trials completed and produced a reward. Per the handout, this is kept as genuine evidence rather than rerun. It demonstrates that a regression case's original 5/5 baseline reflects one sample of a nondeterministic agent, not a permanent guarantee: the same prompt can produce a different reliability result on a fresh set of 5 runs.
